title: Ixel Studio - Work in progress.
author: Ferniclestix
selftext:
A look at something im working on with AI,  theres a little bit of some work in claude where i tell it to fix a bug.  its mostly to show where I'm at on the tool.  
Ill be adding AI based tweening once ive done some skeletal and parenting style tweening. I think its pretty sweet.    Love to hear what people think bout it. :)

If anyone else is interested in how I developed this feel free to ask. This is me using AI to support actual artists :) because disrupting the systems cool 😂

comments.author: Ferniclestix
comments.body:
https://i.redd.it/4wb1h10ovu2i1.gif

further along, interface getting better, better animation handling, keyframing, image swaps, flipping,  per tree bone parenting and graphical isolation to allow layered limbs, foreground background elements.  
added rendering efficiencies, proper bone weight estimation and painting (those are the default weights automatically applied.)  

pixel gap filling for stretches.  
full project and asset managment, embedding.  
still to do, IK rigging, blur, filters, AI content generation.

anyone interested, love to hear suggestions, critique or advice.
